whoItsFor: Developers and CI pipelines that need AWS-compatible services locally for development and testing, without a cloud account, auth token, or paid feature gates. Teams moving off LocalStack can use it as a drop-in replacement.
useCases: Run AWS SDK, CLI, and Terraform tests against a local endpoint in CI
Develop Lambda, DynamoDB, and S3 apps without an AWS account
Replace LocalStack in existing test suites by swapping the image
